第1046章 温清婉与姬云生（第1页）
于此同时，姬云生上方两米处空间被撕开，一道身影从裂缝中坠了下来，直接砸在他怀中，使得连同沙发椅的直接被砸坏，连同带着他以及把凉亭地面，砸出一米深的圆坑。
只见他吃痛一声，睁开双眼骂道：“卧槽？谁他喵的砸我？真是疼死老子了，
话落，一股清冷的雪莲香气，带着那浓郁的血腥味，传入他鼻中，他这才发现压在身上的是什么，使得他满脸懵逼看着温清婉，脑子空白愣住了。
然而这时，与他互相对视着的温清婉，双眼聚焦如同好似看见，某种不可思议之事一样，
足足七八息后，声音有些颤抖问道：“师尊？真的是你吗？”
话一出，姬云生回过神来，有些尴尬回道：“那个.....美女啊！
你能先从我身上下来不？毕竟你这样趴在我身上，未免还是有点暧昧了，若是让别人看到，岂不是又要引起什么误会了。
虽然说我倒是不在意人家说什么，但是这恐怕是对你不太好，所以你能先从我身上下来不？”
温清婉一愣，心里有些失落喃喃道：“嗯？师尊，这是不记得我了吗？可这眼前之人，我绝对不会认错，确实是师尊啊！
虽说气息确实有点不同了，但我十分确信，
可是他为什么不记得我了呢？难道是逆转时空后，导致某种意外情况发生，从而使得如今的师尊，已然是失忆了吗？”
就在此时，一道空灵悦耳的熟悉女声，在她脑海中响起：“小婉，主人目前确实不记得你，毕竟他如今没有过往的记忆，
而我找到他之后，所拥有关于他的记忆也不完整，至于他要什么时候才能恢复记忆，那目前也只能慢慢等下去。
况且如今我的剑身残缺，能和你说这些已然尽力，我还需要大量的时间来恢复，所以接下来就麻烦你保护他了。”
回过神来心里喃喃道：“原来是这样吗？原来第一个找到师尊的，不是我而是阿无姐啊！
既然如此的话，那一次到底是发生了什么，居然连阿五姐都受伤如此严重。”
而后只见她眼角泛起泪光，仅仅一息后，眼泪止不住的流了下来，使得姬云生见状，

满脸懵逼又尴尬的疑惑开口道：“那个，美女啊！
你有没有搞错啊？这咋就哭了起来了呢？明明我也没对你干嘛，反而是你把我砸的，我都感觉骨头都要散架了，我都没哭你哭什么鬼啊？”
温清婉一愣，话也不说仔细的看着，这被他压着却无法反抗的姬云生，
一息后，心里喃喃道：“嗯？师尊如今居然才圣人三重的修为，这还真是有点弱啊！
不过呢，既然师尊如今那么弱，我岂不是可以先下手为强了，如若不这样做的话，那等你娶我的话，还需要等到什么时候？”
只是她说话的同时，眼神也是变得越发炙热起来，
那无比浓烈压制了无数岁月的爱意，也才缓缓释放出来。

The latest chapter of Eternal Lord of All Worlds_Chapter 1046 Wen Qingwan and Ji Yunsheng Page 1_The Eternal Lord of All Worlds, a stranger in the mortal world_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 1046 Wen Qingwan and Ji Yunsheng (page 1)
Chapter 1046 Wen Qingwan and Ji Yunsheng (page 1)
At the same time, the space two meters above Ji Yunsheng was torn open, and a figure fell from the crack and hit him directly in his arms, causing the sofa and chair to be directly smashed, and a one-meter-deep circular pit was created along with him and the ground of the pavilion.
He let out a cry of pain, opened his eyes and cursed: "Fuck? Who the hell hit me? It really hurts me to death.
As soon as he finished speaking, a cold scent of snow lotus, with the strong smell of blood, entered his nose. Only then did he realize what was pressing on him, making him look at Wen Qingwan with a confused face, his mind blank and stunned.
However, at this moment, Wen Qingwan, who was looking at each other with him, focused her eyes as if she saw something incredible,
After seven or eight breaths, he asked with a trembling voice: "Master? Is it really you? "
As soon as the words came out, Ji Yunsheng came back to his senses and replied with some embarrassment: "That... beauty!
Can you get off me first? After all, it's a bit ambiguous for you to lie on top of me like this. If others see it, wouldn't it cause another misunderstanding?
Although I don’t care what others say, I’m afraid this isn’t very good for you, so can you get off me first? "
Wen Qingwan was stunned, feeling a little disappointed and murmured: "Huh? Master, do you not remember me? But I will never admit that the person in front of me is wrong. He is indeed Master!
Although the breath is indeed a little different, I am convinced that
But why doesn't he remember me? Could it be that reversing time and space caused some unexpected situation to occur, causing the current master to lose his memory? "
At this moment, a familiar and ethereal female voice sounded in her mind: "Xiao Wan, the master really doesn't remember you at the moment. After all, he has no memory of the past.
And after I found him, the memory I had about him was incomplete. As for when he would recover his memory, I could only wait slowly for now.
Moreover, now that my sword is incomplete, I have tried my best to tell you this. I still need a lot of time to recover, so I will trouble you to protect him. "
After coming back to his senses, he murmured in his heart: "Is this really the case? It turns out that the first one to find Master was not me but Sister Ah Wu!
If that's the case, what exactly happened that time that even Sister Ah Wu was injured so seriously. "
Then she saw tears welling up in the corners of her eyes. After just one breath, the tears couldn't stop flowing down. When Ji Yunsheng saw this,
With a face full of confusion and embarrassment, he said: "Well, what a beauty!
Did you make a mistake? Why are you crying now? Obviously I didn't do anything to you, but you smashed me. I feel like my bones are falling apart. I didn't even cry. Why are you crying? "
Wen Qingwan was stunned and looked at Ji Yunsheng carefully without saying anything. Ji Yunsheng, who was pressed by him but unable to resist,
After a breath, he murmured in his heart: "Huh? The master is only at the third level of saint cultivation now. This is really a bit weak!
However, since the master is so weak now, shouldn't I be able to strike first and become stronger? If I don't do this, how long will it take for you to marry me? "
But as she spoke, her eyes became hotter and hotter.
The extremely strong love that had been suppressed for countless years was slowly released.
